capabilities.title: Stable workspace identity
capabilities.requirement: Live workspace context, labels, roots, and navigation identity remain stable across local and remote hosts.

capabilities.title: Workspace-scoped AI sessions
capabilities.requirement: Session creation and resume use a validated workspace directory scope with provider-specific directory arguments.

capabilities.title: Workspace runtime ownership
capabilities.requirement: Direct and tmux runtimes retain workspace identity, scope, and display context through their lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Workspace session hydration
capabilities.requirement: Activation, worktree discovery, hydration, pending promotion, and archive behavior expose one coherent workspace session surface.

capabilities.title: Open workspace protocol and recovery
capabilities.requirement: Workspace publication, storage, acknowledgement, and recovery preserve the latest valid semantic state.

capabilities.title: OTHER WINDOWS workspace summaries
capabilities.requirement: The dashboard retains one privacy-bounded summary card per other open workspace without leaking session internals.

capabilities.title: Exact workspace navigation
capabilities.requirement: Navigation uses proven exact capabilities, falls back safely, and never substitutes a member root for a workspace.

capabilities.title: Save workspace as one project
capabilities.requirement: Saved, single-folder, and untitled workspaces persist as one project after migration without duplicate writes.

capabilities.title: Workspace card webview behavior
capabilities.requirement: Workspace cards retain their markup, layout, click targets, responsive containment, and running-state animations, including user-supplied custom running indicators.

capabilities.title: Workspace-aware search
capabilities.requirement: Catalog v2 search targets workspace groups while preserving TODO results and actions.

capabilities.title: Workspace attention lifecycle
capabilities.requirement: Attention identity, persistence, projection, acknowledgement, and stale-evidence suppression remain workspace-aware.

capabilities.title: Exact and bounded tmux focus
capabilities.requirement: Focus verifies the exact tmux target, uses bounded concurrent metadata reads, and retries only after controlled reconciliation.

capabilities.title: Readable durable tmux names
capabilities.requirement: Tmux names remain readable, bounded, identity-safe, promotable, and recoverable while retaining legacy read compatibility.

capabilities.title: Isolated tmux smoke cleanup
capabilities.requirement: Real tmux smoke fixtures remain isolated from user servers and remove their owned servers and temporary roots.

capabilities.title: Reproducible release packaging
capabilities.requirement: Release metadata, clean and repeated builds with residue, bridge compatibility, and exact VSIX allowlists remain reproducible.

capabilities.title: Main capability CI wiring
capabilities.requirement: Deterministic, platform, real-tmux, Extension Host, and packaging checks stay connected to enforced workflows.

capabilities.title: Continuous TODO interaction and layout
capabilities.requirement: TODO refreshes remain incremental while group limits, expansion, card content, and browser layout stay coherent.

capabilities.title: Incremental project catalog consistency
capabilities.requirement: Project discovery, synchronization, conflict handling, and dashboard updates preserve stable cards without full rerenders.

capabilities.title: Attention lifecycle hardening
capabilities.requirement: Attention indicators reflect the newest logical session state and discard stale owners, leases, and persisted evidence.

capabilities.title: Runtime session recovery and activation
capabilities.requirement: Direct, tmux, pending, aliased, and resumed AI sessions preserve identity, apply configured launch policy, and can be activated from their cards.

capabilities.title: Dashboard webview recovery
capabilities.requirement: Dashboard resources, lazy panels, and sidebar providers recover from transient rendering failures without replacing healthy state.

capabilities.title: Current regression CI coverage
capabilities.requirement: Behavior ownership, capability audits, browser contracts, platform workflows, and release packaging remain current and enforced.

capabilities.title: Synchronized AI Prompt library
capabilities.requirement: Global AI Prompts remain ordered, revision guarded, accessible, and insert only into the invocation-time active terminal without Enter.

capabilities.title: Active Session conversation outline
capabilities.requirement: Codex, Kimi, and Claude expose bounded user-input outlines, one sanitized rich conversation viewer, and Host-authoritative comment batches targeting the exact session.

capabilities.title: Configurable central AI skill store with scoped agent links
capabilities.requirement: Skills live in a configurable Global on-disk store or project-relative store with folder trees; per-agent enablement is symlink-based per scope, and every mutation (centralize, migrate, relocate, sync, delete, folder batch) enforces containment and survives authoritative webview refreshes.

capabilities.title: Outbound notification when an AI session stops and needs the user
capabilities.requirement: When an AI session stops with reason completed, input-required or failed, Agent Pivot can send a metadata-only notification to one or more configured IM or push channels. The feature is off by default, keeps credentials out of settings.json, honours proxies, and gates delivery on reason, minimum run duration, debounce, dedup and rate limit.

capabilities.title: Cross-window next running AI session navigation
capabilities.requirement: The Next Running Session command cycles AI sessions whose execution state is running, one jump per invocation, through a stable local-first queue with a resilient cursor: local jumps focus the session terminal and open its conversation, remote jumps hand a one-shot focus request through the Open Windows bridge mailbox so the owning window lands directly on a running session, and the hand-off degrades to a plain window switch when the bridge predates the mailbox channel.

capabilities.title: AI session quick switch and MRU toggle
capabilities.requirement: The Switch to AI Session picker lists every live local session most-recently-focused first plus one entry per other window with running sessions, jumping locally with terminal focus and conversation open or handing off through the focus mailbox with plain-navigation degradation, and Toggle Last AI Session alternates the two most recently focused local sessions from a terminal-focus-fed MRU that prunes dead sessions.

capabilities.title: Voluntary sponsorship entry points
capabilities.requirement: The sponsor command, the dashboard toolbar heart button, FUNDING.yml, and the README badges keep offering the same GitHub star, Ko-fi, and Afdian destinations without interrupting the user.

capabilities.title: One-click quick AI session creation
capabilities.requirement: The AI SESSIONS header split button quick-creates a session with the workspace's remembered provider in one click -- skipping every picker, resolving the Codex profile from the last-used or configured default without prompting, and deferring the multi-root choice to the remembered directory scope -- while the dropdown arrow opens a keyboard-operable menu with one quick entry per provider plus the full interactive flow; the started provider persists per workspace as the next quick-create default.

capabilities.title: In-conversation worktree changes panel
capabilities.requirement: The AI conversation view shows the session task's git changes in place: an immutable per-member baseline is frozen before any physical side effect and persisted with the provisioning intent, provisioning branches from the frozen commit rather than a moved base ref, the telemetry strip carries a Changes button whose counts never render unknown as zero, and a read-only sidebar tab presents the task result relative to each worktree baseline plus the uncommitted working changes grouped the way Source Control groups them.

capabilities.title: Architecture policy harness
capabilities.requirement: Closed-world architecture classification and module registry schema validation stay enforced: every production file has exactly one module and role, and policy references resolve.
